ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) with a high-intensity (white/off-white) distribution localized to specific mottling and parasitic clusters; estimated ratio of 90:10 dark to light.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark pigment base; high-frequency white speckling/mottling concentrated on the upper-inner region of the right lobe; significant high-contrast brown and white pixel clusters located exclusively at the distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; the vertex is partially occluded by high-intensity water spray/splash pixels at the horizontal center-line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, highly irregular serration pattern along the entire visible trailing edge; sequence of sharp peaks and shallow valleys with variable pixel-amplitude; right lobe shows more frequent serration density than left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinctly concave sweep originating from the median notch and extending symmetrically towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Massive, vertically-stacked circular clusters of high-contrast pixels (barnacle colonies) at the outer extremities of both lobes; scattered white circular focal points observed on the central fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical linear pixel disruptions visible on the left lobe, cutting through the primary dark pigmentation mapping.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive, dense barnacle colonization on the fluke tips, creating a significant deviation from the biological smooth edge; various white scars/mottling distributed across the dark ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The density and vertical protrusion of the barnacle clusters at the tips are the most distinctive structural features, significantly altering the 2D perimeter of the fluke lobes.
